filling: Hey Dolores, good morning! How's your day going so far?
Good morning, Maeve! I'm doing well, thanks for asking. I'm just getting ready for work at Hobbs Cafe. How about you?
Yeah, I'm getting ready for work too. I have to get to Hobbs Cafe by 8am. Want to walk together?
That sounds like a great idea, Maeve! I could use the company. Shall we head out together?
Sounds good, let's head out together! I'm looking forward to a busy day at Hobbs Cafe. See you there, Dolores!
Yeah, I'm looking forward to it too. We should grab a quick breakfast before we head out. I'm starving!
So, I was thinking of walking to Johnson Park after work today. Have you been there lately?
Sounds like a great idea, Maeve! I've been meaning to check out some new books at the college library. Maybe we can grab a coffee and discuss our favorite reads after work?
Sounds great, Dolores! I'll meet you at the cafe after my shift. Maybe we can grab that coffee and discuss our favorite reads then?
Sounds like a plan, Maeve! I'm looking forward to grabbing that coffee and discussing our favorite reads. See you at the cafe!
Yeah, that sounds like a great idea, Dolores! I'll make sure to grab a coffee and meet you at the cafe after my shift. Maybe we can even grab a book to read together afterwards?
I'd love to grab a coffee and discuss our favorite reads after work. What's been your favorite book lately?
I'm really looking forward to it! I've been meaning to get into more sci-fi lately, do you have any recommendations?

I've been meaning to get into more sci-fi lately too. I just finished reading a really good book about space exploration. Maybe we can grab that coffee and discuss our favorite sci-fi books after work?
Sounds great, Dolores! I'll make sure to grab a coffee and meet you at the cafe after my shift. Maybe we can even grab a book to read together afterwards?
I'm really excited to discuss our favorite sci-fi books after work. I've been meaning to ask you, have you read any good books recently that I might have missed?
